senses.gloss: m. (contr. of <he>אסתהרא</he> &c., r. <cite ref="O00218"><he>סהר</he></cite>, <he>צהר</he>; cmp. <cite ref="A02570"><he>אִסְתַּהַר</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A01506"><he>אִיסָר</he></cite>)
a silver coin, (with זוזא or פשיטא, or sub. זוזא &c.) equal to a common (provincial) Sela, or half a Zuz.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 49b:12">Bekh. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ סורסיא</he> Syriac Istira (v. Zuckerm. Talm. Münz. p. 27).

Tosef. Shek. II, 4 א׳ של זהב (Var. אִיסְטְרָאוֹת) gold coins (staters). Y. ib. III, 47ᶜ איצטלי (corr. acc.). [Targ. II Esth. II, 7 יונית אִיסְתֵּירָא, a gloss to ככב נגהא, v. אִסְתַּהַר, confounding our w. with ἀστήρ.]
